Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

### New

- **Random night sky.** Pick **Random** under **Sky → Night sky** and every song gets one of the six skies (Aurora, Nebula, Aurora + nebula, Synthwave, Eclipse or Moonlight). The sky stays the same for the whole song, and when the next song starts the old sky fades out before the new one fades in.

### Better

- **Smoother with Glow on.** The soft glow around lines that aren't being sung right now is drawn more cheaply. It looks the same, but costs fewer frames, which helps most in the **Lines** layout.
